name: Honey-Garlic Salmon with Green Beans and Baby Potatoes
description: Honey-garlic glazed salmon roasted on one sheet pan with green beans and baby potatoes. The potatoes get a 20-minute head start, then everything finishes together.
ingredients: 1 lemon (juice of half, rest in wedges)
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with 1 Tbsp oil and half the salt. Spread cut-side down on one side of a large sheet pan and roast 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, whisk the honey, soy sauce, melted butter, garlic, and juice of half the lemon. Pat the salmon dry and season with the pepper and a pinch of salt.

Toss the green beans with the remaining 2 Tbsp oil and the rest of the salt. Pull the pan, flip the potatoes, and scoot them over. Add the green beans and the salmon, skin-side down. Spoon about half the glaze over the salmon.
Roast 12–14 minutes, until the salmon flakes easily and reaches 135–140°F in the thickest part and the green beans are blistered in spots.
Simmer the leftover glaze in a small pan 1–2 minutes until slightly thickened, then brush over the salmon. Serve with lemon wedges.
tips: Thin fillets (under 1 inch) need only 9–10 minutes.
Frozen salmon thaws in about 30 minutes in a sealed bag in cold water — start it when the potatoes go in.
For less salt in the kids' portions, glaze one fillet with just honey, butter, and lemon.
Asparagus works in place of the green beans with the same timing.
